utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh—right, the repair drive. I’m sorry, Nell, my memory’s a bit foggy today, but I’m happy to help however I can.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: No worries — I’ve mostly only heard about it second-hand too, but I can pass along tape, zip ties, work gloves, and flashlights. If anything else comes up, let me know and I’ll spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Nell—that’d be a big help. If you hear the day or time, could you let me know?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Absolutely — send me Bo’s list, and I’ll cross-check it with what I’ve got.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, sorry — I’m a bit behind on this. What’s the latest plan for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: No worries — the latest is we’re mainly gathering tape, zip ties, work gloves, and a few flashlights. If you send me Bo’s list, I’ll compare it with what I’ve got and flag anything missing.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Saturday morning works for me too. What’s the address?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: It’s at my place on Maple Street, just two doors past the corner store. I’ll send the exact number if you need it.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks — send the exact number when you can. I’ll head over Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Sounds good—send me the current list, and I’ll take a look as soon as I can.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’ll send over the current list right away. Thanks for taking a look.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great, thanks, Sam — I’ll keep an eye out for it and see what I can take on.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Can you confirm the timing and the exact drop-off spot?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I can help confirm that—let me check the latest details and get back to you with the timing and drop-off spot. If anything changes, I’ll pass it along right away.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, thanks — I’ll wait for your update, but please confirm it as soon as you can.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, the repair drive? I heard folks are pitching in to get it wrapped up soon—sounds like a real community effort.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That’s right—Saturday at 10 by the community shed. I’ll be there on time, and if you need anything from me, just let me know.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, perfect—Saturday at 10 by the community shed, got it. I’ll spread the word, and if I hear any last-minute needs, I’ll let you know!

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — I can pass along the basics for the repair drive while I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great — let’s pin down the drop-off spot first, then the repair list so nothing slips through.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — tell me the drop-off spot and repair list, and I’ll spread the word while I’m out.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I’ll check the exact drop-off time and let you know soon.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — just send me the basics when you have them, and I’ll handle what I can.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I will—I'll send the basics as soon as I confirm the time.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Saturday morning still works for me, as long as we’re done before pickup time. I just need the drop-off time and final item list confirmed so I can send it to the parents.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can confirm the drop-off time and final list—sounds like we’re still set for Saturday morning, and I’ll make sure the ladder, drill, and screwdrivers are noted.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect — once you send the drop-off time and final list, I’ll get the note out to parents.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sure thing — I’ll keep passing the word about the repair drive around the neighborhood.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Vik — that helps a lot. I’ll send the drop-off spot and repair list next so we can keep everything on track.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good, Rosa — send it over and I’ll keep repeating the drop-off spot and repair list to folks.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, I’ll be there around 10:00 with the tools.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, Mina — thanks for bringing the tools. I’ll keep spreading the word and make sure everyone knows it’s at 10 by the community shed.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Perfect, thanks Quinn. I’ll head over at 10 with the tools and meet everyone by the community shed.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can help, but I still need the timing and the exact drop-off spot first so I can coordinate it cleanly.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it—I’ll check the timing and drop-off spot, then I can text you the details. I’ll still be there a bit late, but I can help set up and haul stuff.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, that works—just text me the timing and exact drop-off spot when you have it, and I’ll plan around that.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can bring my drill and screwdrivers by, and I’ll check if I can borrow a ladder too. What’s still needed most?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m mostly still worried about the timing and the exact drop-off spot. Once I have those, I can help coordinate the rest cleanly.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That makes sense — just send me the time and drop-off spot when you have them, and I’ll work around that.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: That’d be great, Rey—those tools will really help. Kira, tell me what’s still missing and I’ll see what I can lend.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Can you confirm the timing and exact drop-off spot first? I don’t want to assume the repair drive is fully locked in yet.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yep — we’re still locking it in, but I can confirm the timing and drop-off spot as soon as I get the final details.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, the repair drive? I heard folks are pitching in to get it wrapped up soon—sounds like a real community effort.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: It really is — I’m trying to connect the right people, especially anyone handy with appliance fixes or basic carpentry. Once we know who’s available, we can share the locations.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, perfect — I’ll keep an ear out for anyone handy with a wrench or a hammer. If you get the list together, send it my way and I’ll spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’d still like to confirm the details before we count on it—what’s left to sort out?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll check what’s still up in the air and keep spreading the word about the repair drive. If anything changes, I’ll let folks know right away.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Vik — I appreciate you checking and keeping everyone updated. Let me know what’s still uncertain, and I’ll hold off on assuming it’s set.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hi Ira — are we still on for the repair drive, and do you want me to bring the tools around 10:00?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yes — we’re still on, and 10:00 works fine. I’ll send you the basics once I’m back from my errands.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, I’ll bring the tools at 10:00. Just send me the basics when you’re back.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right—the repair drive. What day is that again?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Noah, sorry I’m late—did I miss the repair drive details?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: I think it’s this Saturday at the community center, but I’m a little fuzzy on the drop-off time.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I still need to confirm the drop-off time and the final item list before I can send it out to parents.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — let’s nail it down first. I can start a quick list of who’s bringing what and when we’re kicking off.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That would help a lot — once you’ve got the list, I just need the drop-off time to send it to parents.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Sure—send me the current list, and I’ll pick up what fits my time best.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can check the drop-off time and send it over. I think it’s at the community center this Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Uli—that works for me. Send the drop-off time when you can, and I’ll plan around it.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Saturday at 10 by the community shed works for me. I’ll bring the sign-up sheet and a couple extension cords.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Perfect — Saturday at 10 by the community shed sounds good. Thanks for bringing the sign-up sheet and extension cords; I’ll be there to help.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Great, I’ll see you Saturday at 10 by the community shed. Let’s keep it simple and steady.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’ve only heard bits and pieces, but I can pass along tape, zip ties, work gloves, and flashlights. If anything else comes up, let me know and I’ll spread it around.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Nell — that covers a lot. I’m heading to 14 Maple Street now and will ring the side bell when I get there.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Sounds good — I’ll keep an ear out and let folks know you’re on the way to 14 Maple Street.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I’ll keep us organized and make sure the repair drive runs smoothly. What should we prioritize first?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Let’s start with the drop-off spot and the list of needed repairs, so nothing gets missed.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great — I’ll set the drop-off spot and make the repair list the first priority, then we can add any must-haves as they come in.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Absolutely — I’m happy to help however I can. I just need to remember the details, so if you tell me what time and where, I’ll be there.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Just send me the basics for the repair drive, and I’ll see what I can do.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sure thing — just send me the time, place, and anything you need brought along, and I’ll do my best.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
